system.description:
Forgery is the ability to copy documents, signatures and seals flawlessly.

Obstacles: Mimic document style, Ob 1. Mimic handwriting, Ob 2. Forge signature, Ob 3. Forge stamp/seal, Ob 4. Perfectly duplicate a document, Ob 5. Perfectly duplicate a signature, Ob 6. Perfectly duplicate handwriting, Ob 7. Perfectly duplicate stamp/seal, Ob 8.

FoRKs: Calligraphy, Read, Write, Illuminations, Whitesmith

Skill Type: Special. Tools: Yes. Expendable.

Root: Per/Agi

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 274
